pieces.Text: ; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Con plus confusion for 1 round; cure 2 consecutive saves.  A Leng spider's venom causes flesh to blister and rot away and the mind to experience vivid and horrific hallucinations - these visions cause the poisoned creature to react in an unpredictable manner, as if confused.  The hallucination element of this poison is mind-affecting.
